layouts:split.title: Split
layouts:split.description: The canonical responsive two-column composition with one equal desktop split, semantic alignment, and caller-owned content, influenced by Bauhaus and Swiss editorial layouts.

layouts:media-split.title: Media Split
layouts:media-split.description: One full-bleed media and focused-copy split with a fixed reading measure, fixed media height, and only meaningful side and mobile-order controls.

layouts:overlap.title: Overlap
layouts:overlap.description: A controlled twelve-column overlap for connected image and copy compositions, echoing magazine art direction without absolute-position chaos.
